claims_not_supported: this registration is a design/problem contract and contains no flow evidence
a qualified Stage S derivative or shape improvement is not claimed

design_space.map: delta_cp = B q, B in R^(648 x 16)
design_space.normalization: each mode is scaled so that the maximum absolute normal displacement of the design surface per unit mode coefficient is 1 m
design_space.parameterization: the registered volumetricBSplines morpher is reused unchanged
design_space.q_change_policy: K is fixed at 16; changing K requires a new contract

mode_generation.boundary: zero on the boundary control points
mode_generation.ordering: frequency a^2+b^2+c^2 then (a,b,c) then axis x,y,z
mode_generation.replacement_rule: no replacement after any flow response is read; fewer than 16 surviving modes stops the campaign and requires a new generator version
mode_generation.selection_rule: iterate candidates in order; exclude a candidate if its normal-displacement efficiency is below 0.01 or if either side of its plus/minus max-epsilon preflight fails; the final modes are the first 16 survivors
mode_generation.sign_rule: the largest-magnitude active component is positive (deterministic)
mode_generation.source: geometry-only low-frequency discrete sine modes on the active 6x6x6 lattice
mode_generation.symmetry_rule: y-mirror preserving only: x/z components need b odd, y component needs b even

declared_equals_evaluated.declared: maximize downforce: coefficient +1 on the declared downforce response
declared_equals_evaluated.evaluated: centered FD of the downforce response in mode space; the canonical step direction maximizes downforce, i.e. minimizes J = -downforce; drag is recorded but never optimized
declared_equals_evaluated.response_identity: the primal forceCoeffs downforce response (-Cl) used by the FD side

objective_contract.post_hoc_rule: adding a drag constraint or changing the objective requires a new contract

s2_calibration.design: 3 modes x 4 epsilons x 2 signs, at most 24 primals
s2_calibration.modes: lowest, middle and highest frequency of the selected 16 (deterministic)
s2_calibration.primary_epsilon_rule: the largest ladder epsilon for which all three calibration modes satisfy every requirement; if none does, stop without a gradient
requirements: every side passes the geometry/mesh/solver/stationarity gates
epsilon plateau within the registered tolerance
response change above the registered noise floor
plus/minus odd component dominates the even component
near-zero rule applied to both responses

s3_gradient.claims: gradient qualified in the span of B only
claims_not_supported: the original 648-dimensional adjoint gradient is qualified
a production or multi-step Stage S optimizer exists
s3_gradient.design: all 16 modes at the selected primary epsilon, plus/minus, reusing S2 runs

s4_holdout.directions: 2 random mode directions from the manifest hash + 1 downforce projected-gradient direction
s4_holdout.seed_rule: seed_i = first 8 bytes (big-endian) of sha256(manifest_sha256 + ':holdout:mode:' + i), i >= 1
s4_holdout.stop: any fail or unresolved direction stops the shape step

s5_one_step.acceptance: the actual new-shape primal, never the predicted value
s5_one_step.manifest: a separate one-step manifest must be registered after a complete S4 pass
s5_one_step.multi_step: a successful step never starts a multi-step optimization

stop_conditions: fewer than 16 modes survive the S1 preflight
any baseline lineage, geometry, mesh, convergence or stationarity gate fails
the S2 calibration selects no primary epsilon
the S4 holdout fails or remains unresolved
adding a factor, constraint, scale or direction after seeing a response
